Work.LABEL: Selected Projects
Work.DISCLAIMER: Some of my strongest work sits behind NDAs with agencies and clients, so not everything can be shown publicly. What follows is the part I can show — ask me about the rest.

INDUSTRIES.TITLE: Industry experience
INDUSTRIES.DESCRIPTION: Across both public and private engagements, I’ve shipped products in these domains:

strive.DESCRIPTION: Tell it what you want to learn — or upload your own material — and a chain of LangGraph agents designs the course and writes every lesson. An AI mentor sits inside each one, and spaced review makes it stick. I built this one for myself.

withinly.DESCRIPTION: A relationship and self-insight companion. Chat with an AI that remembers your history, take psychometric assessments, and get AI-written reports — an Inner Portrait for you, and a Relational Portrait once you sync with your partner.

mcr.DESCRIPTION: Manchester place-discovery app. Browse curated venues synced daily from a WordPress CMS, save favorites, and hit 'surprise me' — an AI pipeline embeds your query, vector-searches the directory, and picks your next spot. Perk redemption and booking are built in.

dara.DESCRIPTION: Drop in a candidate's raw CV — and the job spec, if you have it — and an AI agent restructures it into a polished, agency-branded PDF. Output is schema-locked to each template, rendered from JSX, and printed by headless Chrome. Refine it over chat until it's client-ready.

uk-tax.DESCRIPTION: AI tax adviser for UK businesses and sole traders. Upload your financial documents — the agent interprets them and gives step-by-step, jargon-free guidance on tax savings and pay strategy.

circle-of-trust.DESCRIPTION: Networking app where connections mean something. People vouch for each other, recommendations come from real relationships, and the network grows through trust — not cold requests. iOS and Android.

pp-platforma.DESCRIPTION: Construction project management system that keeps teams aligned. Track projects from start to finish, manage payments and bonuses, and give every role—from engineers to accountants—exactly the access they need.
